name: Angcord
description: Angcord was a planet in the galaxy mostly covered in water, with numerous rocky islands blanketed with green trees. During the High Republic Era, a pair of Jedi traveled to Angcord to search for ancient artifacts. The legendary Echo Stone was hidden on Angcord at some point before the High Republic Era.
